name: PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk
summary: PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk, through its subsidiaries, engages in the exploration and development of mineral properties in Asia. The company operates through Investments, Holding Company, and Mining and Services segments. It explores for lead, zinc, gold, copper, and iron ore. The company also invests in shares of stock, as well as engages in funding and financing activities; and offers mining advisory and marketing services. PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia.
